task_metadata.research_topic: learning rate schedule design for training deep convolutional neural networks
task_metadata.research_question: Design a novel learning rate schedule for training deep convolutional neural networks that improves convergence speed and final test accuracy across different architectures and datasets.
notes: The CIFAR citation is recorded via a modern archival DOI for Alex Krizhevsky's original Tiny Images technical report because no canonical conference or journal DOI was exposed through the citation lookup tools.
The Bag of Tricks BibTeX was taken from a publication page surfaced via web search after the citation MCP began rejecting additional requests.

tests.label: resnet20-cifar10
tests.notes: ResNet-20 is a CIFAR-scale instantiation of the original ResNet family; CIFAR-10 comes from the Tiny Images technical report.

tests.label: resnet56-cifar100
tests.notes: Uses the deeper CIFAR ResNet variant on CIFAR-100.

tests.label: mobilenetv2-fmnist
tests.notes: Hidden evaluation pairs MobileNetV2 with Fashion-MNIST.

baselines.name: cosine
baselines.notes: Directly matches the cosine annealing schedule described in SGDR, without using warm restarts.

baselines.name: warmup_cosine
baselines.notes: Matches the linear warmup followed by decay recipe popularized for large-batch ImageNet training.

baselines.name: one_cycle
baselines.notes: Implements the single-cycle learning-rate policy associated with super-convergence.
